settings.heading: Kitchen before spectacle
settings.text: At Savi Hotels & Resorts in Jaipur, Kartavya Jharwal took operating control of a leased property: banquet dayparts, walk-in family lunches, and rooms sharing one kitchen and service spine. We still edit until only the line that can hold volume remains.

settings.heading: Menu honesty
settings.text: At Siya, the property restaurant, the work was a 191-item menu: taxonomy, bills of materials, and pricing staff could audit. What the house prints is what the kitchen can stand behind.

settings.heading: Quiet hospitality
settings.text: The published record prefers playbooks to noise, and a kill gate to a story that will not hold. Maison Tavo opens when the edition is ready — not on a calendar of drops.

settings.heading: Maison Tavo
settings.lede: A food house of considered objects, made to be lived with and remembered. Kartavya Jharwal builds it between London and Jaipur — from hotel kitchens, restaurant menus, and the discipline of a well-run pass.
settings.closing: Kartavya also builds software. This storefront is designed and developed at kartavya.tech. The house itself remains a product house for food.
